name: mnemonic_semantic_entanglement
label: The Semantic Blight
godotFeature: GDScript for procedural generation logic, ShaderMaterial for visual data blending, and NavigationMesh for pathing ambiguity.
poeticVision: Players will experience the visceral confusion of a world actively losing its meaning. The familiar becomes alien, paths become riddles, and the very fabric of reality warps not just in form, but in purpose. Every step is a question, every landmark a lie, forcing Lyra to question not just where she is, but what anything truly is, reflecting her own dissolving identity in the environment itself. The fear isn't just of collapse, but of disorientation and existential illegibility.

parameters.name: blight_intensity
parameters.description: Controls the intensity of semantic corruption, from 0.0 (no blight) to 1.0 (full blight). Affects material blending and complexity of added geometry.

parameters.name: target_node
parameters.description: The target 3D node (MeshInstance3D or CSGCombiner3D) to apply the semantic blight to.

parameters.name: memory_fragments
parameters.description: An array of MemoryFragmentResource objects, each containing PBR textures for blending.

verdict: The world itself becomes a fractured mirror, reflecting Lyra's fading self in a dance of beautiful, terrifying illegibility.
impact: The Semantic Blight will fundamentally transform the player's perception of the game world, turning familiar environments into treacherous, ever-shifting puzzles. It will deepen the emotional impact of Lyra's identity loss by mirroring her internal struggle with a visually and structurally disorienting external reality, forcing constant adaptation, critical thinking, and a profound sense of existential unease. Every step becomes a desperate act of deciphering a world that actively resists legibility, making survival a battle against both physical threats and the erosion of meaning itself.
